walkthrough: Goal: a beginner who finds it hard to keep practising sets a timer of 15 minutes and practises until it rings, lesson after lesson with nothing asking in between, then rests five minutes; the day's seal is in the home and the book.

Entry: the home. Under the next lesson a quiet Pomodoro label and its row: a ring with one hand, 15, 25 and 40 with 25 ringed, min, and Start timer in its pill (on its own line under the lengths where the row leaves it no room). 40, then 15: the ring moves, nothing starts; 15 is kept.

Start timer: the first lesson opens on today's sheet; the bar reads the ring, 15 min, First lesson 1/3, Next. The tablet put down four minutes with the sheet in front: 11 min, the ring's ink arc grown. Next, Next, Finish: no lesson's end; Lesson 2 · Ghosted lines is laid on the next row (first in the course, S156) and the view glides to it, its How first.

The ring is a control: Pause and Stop timer under it. Pause: Paused in grey, the ring pale; five minutes later still 11 min; the ring, Continue. Home: the home's row shows the ring, 11 min and Continue (no lengths, no Start timer); ten minutes on the home count nothing. Continue: the sheet again at 11 min, its How not again (told once). The app hidden ten minutes: still 11 min.

A line drawn, then eleven minutes: Time in the seal's red, the ring whole and red, End in its pill where Next was, the screen still kept on. Nothing cut the stroke: a second stroke, Compare, Accurate. End: the bar says Pomodoro done; the sheet keeps the rows drawn, the exercises not begun gone; the card: 15 minutes and its red seal, 2 lessons · 4 exercises, the results as marks, Break with its pale ring and 5 min, Another pomodoro, That's all for today. The screen is kept on while the break counts.

Three minutes; the app hidden ten minutes and back: the block's end as it was, its break held. Two minutes more: one chime, the break's ring whole in ink, Break alone; the screen may sleep. Another pomodoro: 15 min again on the next lesson. One exercise drawn and judged Almost, then the time: End, 1 lesson · 2 exercises. That's all for today: the home with Today and two small red seals at Practice's right, the row back to its lengths with 15 ringed. The practice book: Monday 5 October, 10 min and two seals beside it.

Start timer, three minutes, the app closed and started again: the sheet at 12 min. Home: Continue on the row. Continue, the ring, Stop timer: the ring and the minutes go, the lesson goes on untimed; the home offers Start timer, still two seals.
Start timer, then Home: the block held. The tablet left overnight: the block is gone, no seal, the row offers its lengths and Start timer.

The practice options' Break chime switched off; a block run to its time with nothing drawn in it: End leaves it as Stop timer does, no end card, no break, no seal, Next where it was. Another with a line drawn, End, its break over: no chime.
